## Microsoft Gross Margin: FY2023 → FY2024

**Source data** [DOC: msft_margin.txt — Microsoft Corporation 10-K FY2024, accession 0000950170-24-087843]:

| | FY2024 (YE 6/30/2024) | FY2023 (YE 6/30/2023) |
|---|---|---|
| Revenue | $245,122M | $211,915M |
| Cost of revenue | $74,114M | $65,863M |
| **Gross margin ($)** | **$171,008M** | **$146,052M** |
| **Gross margin (%)** | **69.76%** | **68.92%** |

**Comparability note:** Both figures are drawn from the same FY2024 10-K (FY2023 shown as the comparative column), so they are on a consistent presentation basis, and both are 12-month periods ending June 30 — no fiscal-year mismatch. One caveat: the excerpt provided contains only the consolidated revenue and cost-of-revenue lines and no accompanying disclosure on acquisitions, segment redefinitions, or accounting-estimate changes, so I cannot verify from this source whether FY2024 includes partial-year results from an acquisition (which would make the year-over-year margin change partly mix-driven rather than purely organic).

**Result:** Gross margin **improved** by approximately **0.84 percentage points** (69.76% − 68.92%), with gross profit dollars rising from $146,052M to $171,008M (+17.1%) on revenue growth of 15.7% — i.e., revenue grew faster than cost of revenue (+12.5%), which is what drove the margin expansion.

ANSWER: Improved — gross margin rose from 68.92% in FY2023 to 69.76% in FY2024, an increase of approximately 0.84 percentage points (~0.8 pp)
